document.title: Foreign Partner's Information Statement of Section 1446 Withholding Tax

boxes.label: Total tax credit allowed to partner under section 1446
For partnership's calendar year
boxes.note: Or the partnership's tax year beginning and ending dates - which partnership year the credit belongs to.

boxes.label: Foreign partner's name
U.S. identifying number
Address (if a foreign address, see instructions)
Account number assigned by partnership (if any)
Type of partner (specify—see instructions)
Country code of partner (enter two-letter code—see instructions)
Name of partnership
U.S. Employer Identification Number (EIN)
Address (if a foreign address, see instructions)
Withholding agent's name
Withholding agent's U.S. EIN
Check if the partnership identified on line 5a owns an interest in one or more partnerships
Check if any of the partnership's effectively connected taxable income (ECTI) is exempt from U.S. tax for the partner identified on line 1a
Partnership's ECTI allocable to partner for the tax year (see instructions)
Name of beneficiary
U.S. identifying number of beneficiary
Address (if a foreign address, see instructions)
Amount of ECTI on line 9 to be included in the beneficiary's gross income (see instructions)
Amount of tax credit on line 10 that the beneficiary is entitled to claim on its return (see instructions)

document.notes: Continuous-use form; the revision in force for 2025 is Rev. November 2019.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader - which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over every line the Rev. 11-2019 face prints (spec 080 T047).

custom.reads: a Form 8805, Foreign Partner's Information Statement of Section 1446 Withholding Tax.
